Name: Siasz's Maru Portrait
Author: Siasz
Description: This is my first real drawing in over 6 years, first time on a tablet, and first time uploading a mod. Also may not be as crispy clean as some of the photos I uploaded since I don't understand any of this. Please be nice! I hope you enjoy. All Maru Portraits are complete! Let me know which character you'd like to see next.

Downloads.Description: Download the file, go into the zipped folder, copy and paste all 3 Maru images into your Portraiture folder containing all the images you're using in game. It might ask if you'd like to replace any current Maru images, click yes.
